titulo_fr: Lire plusieurs documents : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Integrated functional reading: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It integrates data from a poster, a schedule and a short message. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It integrates data from a poster, a schedule and a short message. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Point of attention: Compare date, place and condition between documents; do not assume that two similar figures refer to the same. In this fragment, «heure» means «time».

frases.fr: Le billet coûte quatre euros et le rendez-vous est devant l'entrée principale.
frases.es: El billete cuesta cuatro euros y el punto de encuentro está delante de la entrada principal.
frases.en: The ticket costs four euros and the meeting point is in front of the main entrance.

frases.fr: Le musée ferme à dix-sept heures; la visite dure une heure.
frases.es: El museo cierra a las cinco; la visita dura una hora.
frases.en: The museum closes at 5: 00; the visit takes an hour.
